description:
We are a team of five students passionate about space science. We are tackling the challenge to "Identify Earth Locations that Analog Moon and Mars." We have researched sites like the Atacama Desert and Mistastin Crater to see how they mimic space environments.
We need teammates with:
Design skills: To create visual presentations/maps.
Google Earth skills: To plot coordinates.
Passion for space!
Join a motivated team ready to build a great solution for NASA!
